verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites directly match the story. Each agent gets its own Linux box that checkpoints itself while the agent works, so harnesses like Claude and Codex find everything where they left it. Sprites sleep and wake remembering everything, keep a persistent disk of up to 100 GB, and can roll back to any checkpoint in seconds. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how checkpointing works (frequency, retention, API/CLI control), independent or hands-on corroboration that automatic checkpointing works as claimed.
